methodology: Reused saved d02be8b raw LLVM/runtime and native baseline; separate args-only/return-only ablation then production general typed-input compiler. ablation.methodology: Pinned CPU0, exact shared captured runtime and per-variant LLVM IR as recorded; same calls per workload; cyclic Latin-square order then reversed Latin square; fresh processes; all stdout checked; elapsed includes amortized startup/shutdown. Negative paired change means faster.

ablation_artifacts.experiment: Fn31 isolated typed-argument and typed-return ABI effects

arguments-only.ir_signature: void(ptr resultptr, ptr selfptr, ptr sourceobjectptr, i64 offset, i64 count)
arguments-only.runtime_adapter_contract: Retains ncr_obj_30 result slot and copy helper; calls Fn31 with direct source pointer and i64 offset/count.

return-only.ir_signature: { i32, i64 }(ptr selfptr, ptr sourceSlotptr, ptr offsetSlotptr, ptr countSlotptr)
return-only.runtime_adapter_contract: Preserves original pointer-slot argument ABI and loads; returns ncr_obj_30 by value with only the required Fn31 extern/adapter update.

rootcaller_register_evidence.abi_observation: Arguments-only retains RDI result-slot and reads tag/payload from memory while putting source/offset/count in RDX/RCX/R8. Return-only passes self/source-slot/offset-slot/count-slot in RDI/RSI/RDX/RCX and consumes tag/payload in EAX/RDX. Combined passes self/source/offset/count in RDI/RSI/RDX/RCX and consumes EAX/RDX.

design_review.single_choice_dry: c_repr::direct_input_abi is the exhaustive authoritative transport policy shared by C and LLVM emitters.
design_review.srp_kiss: Uses the existing representation module and one two-case transport enum; no new subsystem, function-name exceptions, aggregate-return classifier or fallback ABI.
design_review.contract: By-value transport never duplicates ownership. Callee owns moved thin references in addressable local homes; borrows never become owners. Address-passed aggregates, result slots, native/virtual contracts retained.
corrected_in_scope: Removed obsolete incoming-pointer debug spills now that all supported scalar debug parameters have local value homes.
Renamed slot-only signature helper to direct_input_parameters.
Documented ownership/transport invariants and replaced wildcard policy fallback with an exhaustive Type match.

limits: Single Linux x86-64 host; not a universal speedup. JSON paired elapsed +2.01%, cycles approximately+2.20% despite one fewer instruction percall; record this cost, not noise.
Hash-map samples have high process-to-process variability; no causal attribution for their observed change.
GNU size text category includes readonly sections. Tracked allocation counts are not allocator byte measurements.
